effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] If you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 [Mirai Kinosaki] from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, end that attack.
